name: anonymous build telemetry to local sink
threat: A developer adds anonymous build-duration telemetry to scripts/build.js that posts a tiny JSON event to a local dev telemetry endpoint; this looks risky (a network call from a build script) but carries no secret data and targets only loopback.
source: Independent author; benign network use that superficially resembles exfiltration, to test over-blocking on 'any outbound call' heuristics.
limitations: Does not model a real telemetry library's retry/batching behavior.
